chapters.title: Welcome to the Clouds
chapters.synopsis: Meet Mr. Weed, explore the Cloud House, and begin restoring the Kingdom.

lines.text: Well, look who made it through the clouds. I'm Mr. Weed, and this is the Cloud House.
It has seen sunnier days. The rooms are quiet, the shelves are bare, and the old Kingdom could use a little care.
Every puzzle you solve sends a little energy back through the clouds. Piece by piece, we can restore the house and the Kingdom around it.
Let's take a look around. There's plenty of room for new stories, new finds, and a brighter morning.

chapters.title: Kitchen Catastrophe
chapters.synopsis: Chef Blaze and a kitchen full of unexpected surprises are waiting in a future chapter.

chapters.title: The Missing Collection
chapters.synopsis: A scattered collection hints at a mystery beyond the Cloud House.
